summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting entry into a $50 million asset-based revolving credit facility by Borrower Andersen Tax LLC, with Andersen Group Inc. as a guarantor. The facility matures in three years, priced at Term SOFR plus 175 bps, with a 25 bps unused fee and no early termination fee. Borrowings are secured by eligible receivables. This is a routine debt financing for general corporate purposes, working capital, and permitted acquisitions, not a special situation. No stock, activist, tender, spin-off, or restructuring elements are present.
